name: P8 · Orders sync (hourly) + daily Excel export

parameters.query: select p8_sync_since('orders') as orders_since, p8_sync_since('inventory_levels') as inventory_since;

select case $1 when 'orders' then p8_sync_orders_page($2::jsonb)
            else p8_sync_inventory_page($2::jsonb) end as result;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $json.streams[$json.idx].query, variables: { first: $json.streams[$json.idx].first, after: $json.after, q: $json.streams[$json.idx].q } }) }}
